seo.title: Privacy & Trust - How BioMath Core Protects Your Data
seo.description: Learn how BioMath Core protects your health data with encryption, HIPAA-aligned practices, GDPR compliance, and user-controlled sharing. Read our privacy policies and security practices.

hero.label: Privacy & Trust
hero.title: Your data, protected by design
hero.body: Health data is deeply personal. BioMath Core treats its protection as a core product requirement — with transparent practices and plain-language policies.

commitments.label: Commitments
commitments.title: Our commitment to your privacy
commitments.body: Six principles that guide every product and engineering decision.

items.title: End-to-end encryption
items.body: Health data is encrypted at rest and in transit using AES-256 and industry-standard TLS.

items.title: You control your data
items.body: You decide what to share, who can access it, and can export or delete it at any time.

items.title: HIPAA-aligned practices
items.body: We follow HIPAA requirements for protecting sensitive health information.

items.title: Secure infrastructure
items.body: Data stored in SOC 2 certified data centers with regular security audits.

items.title: GDPR compliance
items.body: Full compliance with European data protection regulations and user rights.

items.title: No data selling
items.body: We never sell your data. Privacy is a design constraint, not a revenue stream.

policies.label: Policies
policies.title: Transparency & compliance
policies.body: Full legal documentation is public and written in plain language.

control.label: Control
control.title: Your data, your control
control.body: You have the right to access, export, or delete your data at any time. No questions asked.

contact.label: Questions
contact.title: Questions about privacy?
contact.body: Our privacy team is here to help. If you have questions about how we protect your data, reach out anytime.
